title: Patient Payment Plan Training Bulletin: Installments for the Time an Assistance Application Has Waited
content:
On a **Patient Payment Plan** installment change, the lengthened schedule also takes in installments for the time the open application has been waiting since its receipt date, which is that case's application date. A financial assistance application of the patient is open when one of the patient's financial assistance cases in the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) stands in submitted or pending documents status, a submitted case being taken first. Status, receipt date and documents due date are read from the case in the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care).

**Rule.**
- For a case in pending documents status: the due dates after the receipt date that have already come, up to the earlier of the handling date and the case's documents due date, counted as the whole months from the first due date to that earlier date less the whole months from the first due date to the receipt date (a receipt date before the first due date counting as one month before it), and never fewer than none.
- For a case in submitted status: one installment for each full 30 days from the receipt date to the handling date.
- With no open application: none.

Whole months are counted the calendar way: a month complete only once the later date's day number reaches the earlier date's day number (from the 31st, a month without that day is not yet complete at its last day).

**Q. Pending documents; first due date 1 February; receipt 12 April; documents due 20 June; handling date 5 July.**
A. The earlier date is 20 June. Whole months from 1 February to 20 June are 4; from 1 February to 12 April, 2. 4 less 2 gives 2 installments (1 May and 1 June).

**Q. Submitted; received 95 days before the handling date.**
A. 95 days hold 3 full periods of 30 days: 3 installments.

**Q. Pending documents; receipt 20 January, before a first due date of 1 March; handling date 10 April, documents due later.**
A. The receipt date lies before the first due date, so it counts as one month before it: minus one. Whole months from 1 March to 10 April are 1. 1 less minus one gives 2 (1 March and 1 April).
